programme.title: Vimbldonas. World Feed Day 8 7/7/25
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.desc: On the day Turbo unveils a new cologne he has created, birds suddenly start attacking the city and it's up to the crew to figure out how to get rid of the feathery menaces before anyone gets eaten/Travelling through the desert to visit a kid snail who is sick, the crew runs afoul of a villainous sheriff who puts them in jail until Turbo agrees to throw a race.

programme.title: Dinotrux
programme.desc: The Dinotrux builds a garage where the Reptools can be safe, but D-Structs tries to thwart their efforts by pitting them against one another.

programme.title: The Mr. Peabody And Sherman Show
programme.desc: Sherman begs Peabody to keep a Wolly Mammoth he names Captain Cools as his pet; Marco Polo wins three deadly noodle challenges to discover spaghetti.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Bully For You When Casper decides he can't take any more of Thatch's nastiness, he forms a secret squad dedicated to putting an end to bullying. The Ra-minator Using the power of invisibility, Casper offers to help transform Ra from a sports zero to an athletic hero.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective
programme.desc: Everyone is excited about singing sea shanties in the big Pirate Party in Toyland. But when Scurvy the Parrot arrives at Toy Green all on his own Noddy soon realises that the pirates are missing. Where can they have gone? Noddy uses his best investigating skills of tracking, listening, looking and thinking to follow the clues and find out what's happened to the pirates - not helped by a loudly squawking Scurvy! When he discovers that the pirates have lost their voices from over-practising their new sea shanty, Noddy comes up with an idea for how Scurvy's loud voice can help save the day. Clever Noddy!

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service
programme.desc: Julian is very excited about the Sealife Awareness Day at Greendale School. While he's talking to Pat about it, his dad gets a call from Ben - a special delivery! Pat discovers it's a giant inflatable shark which is to be the surprise centrepiece of the Sealife day. But when Pat stops to help Alf mend a gate, a mix-up with parcel tape ends up with the whale accidentally inflating and floating off... Pat must use his ingenuity to catch the whale and - most important of all - deliver it in time for the special Sealife Awareness event...

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble deliver lots of delicious honey to Poppy's stall. They lose a pot on the way and there isn't enough to go round. Can they find the missing pot, or will Stingo have to go without his honey for tea?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Huffty has lost his voice. While Raa Raa and his friends try and work out what has happened to it, Huffty has to mime to make himself understood.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: Tag can't wait to show off her car at the car show. But when Cheddar Biscuit wants to come along and pick up her clown friends along the way, Tag is wary that Cheddar Biscuit will steal her thunder. \\ The Not Yet Cadets can't wait to watch Sam’s big race. But when Sam loses his car key, he challenges the Not Yet Cadets to race around town to find it.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: When Pixie’s pet crab goes into a cave, Kelp uses his knowledge of crabs under the sea to coax him out using dance and rhythm. / Scallop’s special shell is broken, but Kelp transforms the broken bits into something even more special.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: When Erica makes fun of George and Harold’s latest and greatest comic, they make a comic about her becoming a vampire.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business
programme.desc: When Baby Corp babies start aging, panic hits the office and the babies set out to find out if someone has been tainting the formula.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: After a crowverine gliding mishap, Dawn loses her confidence and tells Eep she's taking a break from adventures. Eep convinces Dawn to join her on one last adventure – climbing Grrr Mountain.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: With the sudden closing of a local candy shop, NaiNai is busy trying to recreate its famous candied fruit. But after a late-night sugar binge in NaiNai’s stash, Peng starts acting strangely. It turns out that he’s possessed by magical creatures! The Minticon are sugar-addicted puffball creatures, who previously lived in the old candy shop. Armed with her violin, Yi commands the creatures out of Peng’s body, winning over the Minticon in the process.

programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Story: Ajax - Manchester United 2017. Finale - Alla Friends Arena di Stoccolma Ajax e Man Utd vogliono entrare nella storia di una competizione che regalera' al vincitore l'accesso alla prossima Champions. TC: Marianella-Marocchi.

programme.title: Liverpool, Simply The Best
programme.desc: La colonna sonora della splendida stagione del Liverpool in Premier League: abbiamo selezionato i brani che raccontano i gol di tutti i marcatori dei Reds, a partire da Mo Salah.

programme.title: Manchester City - Tottenham
programme.desc: Premier League: Manchester City - Tottenham. 12a g. - Entrambe reduci da una sconfitta con Brighton e Ipswich. City a -5 dal Liverpool. Un solo successo degli Spurs nelle ultime 9 sfide all'Etihad Stadium. TC: Massimo Marianella.

programme.title: Antonio Conte 2a Parte
programme.desc: Dagli insegnamenti di Trapattoni, allo scudetto col Napoli e l'accordo per restare. Conte svela come si costruisce una cultura vincente: dare e chiedere tutto, poi ricominciare.

programme.title: Juventus - Torino
programme.desc: Serie A: Juventus - Torino. 12a g. - Bianconeri tornati a vincere (0-2 a Udine) dopo 2 pari. -4 dal Napoli. Toro con 5 ko in 6 giornate. Non vince un derby da 9 anni, 5 pareggi e 15 sconfitte. TC: Zancan-Marchegiani.

programme.title: Ep 113
programme.desc: Ep 113 - Sport Dataroom.

programme.title: Calciomercato - L'originale
programme.desc: Curiosità, commenti, notizie e anticipazioni sui possibili movimenti del calciomercato. Condotto dal trio Alessandro Bonan, Gianluca Di Marzio e Fayna.

programme.title: La favola di B. Clough
programme.desc: Dalla serie B al tetto d'Europa per due volte consecutive: la favola del Muhammad Ali del calcio inglese, Brian Clough e del suo Nottingham Forest.

programme.title: Ep. 2
programme.desc: Ep2 - I momenti che hanno reso unica la Champions League raccontati da chi l'ha vinta: in questo episodio i protagonisti di Bayern Monaco, Ajax e Juventus.

programme.title: Stoccarda - Atalanta
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League: Stoccarda - Atalanta. 4a g. - Tedeschi a quota 4 punti dopo il successo sulla Juventus (0-1). Atalanta ancora imbattuta con 5 punti e con la porta ancora inviolata. Nessun precedente. TC: Marianella-Minotti.

programme.title: Roma - Athletic Bilbao
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League: Roma - Athletic Bilbao. 1a g. - Giallorossi in Europa per l'11esima stagione di fila. L'Athletic ci torna dopo 5 anni. Club spagnoli in vantaggio 23 a 14 in 44 sfide con la Roma, 7 pari. TC: Gentile-Montolivo.

programme.title: Salisburgo - Paris
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League: Salisburgo - Paris. 6a g. - Austriaci 32esimi dopo il 4° ko (5-0 a Leverkusen). PSG al 25esimo posto dopo 2 ko di fila (Atletico Madrid e Bayern). Una vittoria a testa nei 2 precedenti. TC: Davide Polizzi.

programme.title: Dinamo Kiev - Lazio
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League: Dinamo Kiev - Lazio. 1a g. - Entrambe in Europa League per la sesta volta nelle ultime 8 stagioni. Lazio imbattuta nei 4 precedenti europei con il bilancio di 3 vittorie e un pari. TC: Compagnoni-Marchegiani.

programme.title: Ep.2
programme.desc: Ep2 - In questa puntata diamo uno sguardo a quattro dei piu' illustri allenatore che hanno vinto la UEFA Champions League: Mourinho, Ancelotti, Rijkaard e Di Matteo.
